name: Blind Jumps
description: GD is too easy! Make every jump blind.

jccolour.name: Blind Colour
jccolour.description: The colour that covers your screen when you are 'blind')

cimage.name: Custom Blind Image
cimage.description: Custom image to blind you with (Requires <cy>Blind Colour</cy> to be set to <cr>Custom</cr>). It also works with <cb>transparent images</cb> just note it **scales to fit**

flashbangduration.name: Flashbang Duration
flashbangduration.description: How long the fading out on the flashbang takes

foduration.name: Fade Out Duration
foduration.description: How long the fading out from Fade Out mode takes.

minp.name: Minimum %
minp.description: Minimum percentage to be blinded at

maxp.name: Maximum %
maxp.description: Maximum percentage to be blinded at

pmode.name: Blind in platformer
pmode.description: Choose how you want it to blind you in platformer. **IT IS RECOMMENDED TO KEEP THIS TO NEVER, AS OTHER SETTINGS ARE A BIT BUGGY**

fbsound.name: Enable Flashbang Sound
fbsound.description: Plays a sound when you are blinded. This works <cr>without</c> flashbang mode enabled and <cr>**IS HEAVILY NOT RECOMMENDED**</c> (like seriously please do not turn this on unless you want to go deaf)

buttoninp.name: Button in pause menu
buttoninp.description: Shows a button in the pause menu to quick-edit the settings.
